overall: The AG found the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by posting an executive-session-only notice without indicating an initial open session, and did not review the minutes allegation first raised on appeal.

allegations.summary: The July 5 meeting notice listed only an executive session and did not say the board would first convene in open session.
In a request for further review, the complainant alleged the board failed to make meeting minutes available; this was not in the original complaint.
allegations.key_passage: Because these allegations were not part of the original complaint, we do not review them now.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law
remedy_passage: We order the Board's immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, and we caution that similar future violations may be considered evidence of intent to violate the law.
